newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Ico EMTN programme rated AA by Ibca.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Ico EMTN programme rated AA by Ibca.

text.p: U.K. rating agency IBCA said on Friday it rated the $2 billion Euro Medium Term Notes programme of the Spanish official credit agency Instituto de Credito Oficial (ICO) at A1+ for short-term, and at AA for longer-term debt.

The agreement to issue up to $2 billion in EMTN multi-currency was announced yesterday. The programme has no deadline and might be renewed on a yearly basis. The arranger is Goldman Sachs. The paper can be issued in maturities ranging from one month to 30 years.

Ibca explains that ICO is a credit institution with the legal status of a state-owned company and is responsible to Spain's Ministry of Finance. All funds placed with ICO benefit from a state guarantee.
